title: Professional Email Seat Catch-Up: Seat Price by Billing Plan
content:
The plan seat price of a Professional Email seat catch-up is read from the billing plan and the calendar months of the term on the subscription record.

| Billing plan and term | Plan seat price |
|---|---|
| annual billed monthly, a 12-month term billed monthly | the product's annual-billed-monthly seat price |
| monthly, a term of one calendar month | the product's month-to-month seat price, the month-to-month price above the annual commitment |
| otherwise | the product's annual-prepaid seat price |

The prices are those of the product's price schedule.

Examples (hypothetical subscriptions): a seat catch-up on Microsoft 365 Business Standard on the annual-billed-monthly plan over a 12-month term is priced at the annual-billed-monthly 13.13 per seat; on Harborline Mail Pro on the monthly plan over a one-month term at the month-to-month 7.49; on Harborline Mail Starter on the annual prepaid plan at 1.99.
